#| echo: false

# The page's data: the two CV tables plus the dot grid for the map.
rd <- function(f) read.csv(f, encoding = "UTF-8", check.names = FALSE, na.strings = character())
payload <- list(
  experience = rd("data/cv/experience.csv"),
  publications = transform(rd("data/cv/publications.csv"), year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year))),
  world = jsonlite::fromJSON("assets/data/world.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
)
json <- jsonlite::toJSON(payload, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
cat("```{=html}\n<script id=\"cv-data\" type=\"application/json\">", gsub("</", "<\\/", json, fixed = TRUE),
    "</script>\n<script src=\"assets/js/about.js\" defer></script>\n<script src=\"assets/js/nav.js\" defer></script>\n```\n", sep = "")
```
